title: EnvAgent: Multi-Agent Approach to Building Science Environments in the Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2611.23258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents are transforming scientific computing and software workflows, but generating and executing code requires a correctly configured execution environment. Automating environment construction remains difficult because repositories encode heterogeneous, often incomplete requirements for operating systems, toolchains, dependencies, and build procedures. Existing workflows thus rely on developer-maintained Dockerfiles and setup scripts, making preparation labor-intensive, hard to scale, and potentially biasing evaluations. We present ENVAGENT, an agentic framework that synthesizes, builds, and verifies repository-level Docker environments. ENVAGENT combines deterministic utilities for Docker execution and state management with coordinated agents for repository analysis, planning, Dockerfile synthesis, and iterative failure diagnosis and repair. translated_title: EnvAgent：在云端构建科学环境的多智能体方法
translated_abstract: AI智能体正在变革科学计算和软件工作流程，但生成和执行代码需要正确配置的执行环境。由于代码仓库中包含针对操作系统、工具链、依赖项和构建过程的异构且往往不完整的需求，自动化环境构建仍然十分困难。因此，现有工作流程依赖于开发人员维护的Dockerfile和安装脚本，这使得环境准备工作既费力又难以扩展，并可能导致评估产生偏差。我们提出了ENVAGENT，一个用于综合、构建和验证仓库级Docker环境的智能体框架。ENVAGENT将用于Docker执行和状态管理的确定性实用程序，与负责仓库分析、规划、Dockerfile综合以及迭代式故障诊断和修复的协同智能体相结合。我们还介绍了ENVBENCH，这是一个包含54个科学成果和开源代码仓库的基准测试。
tldr: 提出了EnvAgent多智能体框架，能够自动综合、构建和验证仓库级Docker环境，并引入ENVBENCH基准（包含54个科学成果）来评估科学计算环境自动化构建的效果。
en_tdlr: EnvAgent is a multi-agent framework that automatically synthesizes, builds, and verifies repository-level Docker environments, paired with ENVBENCH, a benchmark of 54 scientific artifacts for evaluating automated environment construction.
